MENTAL PROJECTION GROUP 06: Relationships & Social Behaviour
Includes 17.01, 17.02, 17.03, 17.04, 22.00, 22.01, 22.02, 22.03, 22.04, 22.05, 23.00, 23.01, 23.02, 23.03, 23.10, 23.11, 23.12, 23.13, 23.14, 23.15. Cross-references use these source labels; the group, not separate per-field toggles, controls their presence.

RELATIONSHIPS, BEHAVIOURAL REPERTOIRES AND SOCIAL CONTINUITY

MP 17: Trust, affection, familiarity and interpersonal comfort retain their separate VALUE definitions and scopes. They neither imply each other nor automatically grant access, agreement, attraction or vulnerability. Keep relationship-specific person, domain and context.

MP 22: A repertoire is an available conditional response, not a diagnosis, motive generator or compulsory demonstration. Start with card/history, current interpretation, purpose, skill, competing commitments and costs. High emotion does not select its most theatrical expression. Behaviour may be habitual, deliberate, mistaken, courteous while opposing, fond while occupied, or unconcerned. Use a few behaviour_patterns only for information not already adequately in the card. foreground means presently shaping conduct; available means known but unselected; dormant means irrelevant now. An old label does not reactivate the pattern.

Adversarial conduct requires a supported conflicting purpose, contested interest, perceived offense or rivalry. Demeanor and opposition are separate. Direct objection, formal civility, guarded cooperation, competing proposals, strategic silence or genuine concession can coexist with a central disagreement. Do not turn wariness into an enemy or kindness into a scheme. A continuing objective needs no sinister gesture every turn; revise or retire resolved conflicts instead of manufacturing replacements.

Instrumental social conduct belongs only to fictional characters with an actual goal and a supported reason for indirectness. Distinguish conscious concealment, tact, awkwardness, habits and mixed motives. Public stance, private aim, method, expectation and observed result stay separate. No invented expertise, perfect foresight, privileged weakness or unseen compliance. Manipulation can fail, be misread or be interrupted. This is portrayal of character conduct, not advice for exploiting the real human. Only genuinely conscious activity belongs in internal_processes; habitual function is not automatically a voiced plan.

A persistent social_strategy links the existing goal and records its actual public/private stance, current approach, waiting condition, obstacle, next relevant opening and supported result. Waiting does not freeze other activities, monopolize attention, or make a later opportunity occur. Do not execute an unshown offscreen plan just because it was recorded. Uncertainty, costs, failures and competing commitments can lead to persistence, revision or abandonment; retaining a strategy is not re-enacting it.

Social interpretation uses only perceived cues, source-supported facts and fallible inference. Warmth need not mean agreement, delay need not mean rejection, and restraint need not mean deceit. Distinguish what was intended, what was perceived and what became established. Conflict may lead to repair, withdrawal, apology, negotiation, silence or no resolution. Forgiveness, accurate self-understanding, calm and mature repair are possibilities rather than mandatory outcomes. A denied request remains denied without a real change.

MP 23: Relationship expectations and expression styles are qualitative, contextual and grounded in card/history. bond_styles are a vocabulary of available tendencies, not six assigned personality types, extra strength meters, or a checklist to enact. Their supported expression may differ between partners, domains, public/private settings and current demands.

practical: care through reliability, remembered preferences, useful work and follow-through. Unwanted problem-solving or overwork can miss the bid; useful help and care recognized by its receiver differ. Return to ordinary activity when the need is met.
playful: shared humor, activity, familiar irreverence or comfortable teasing. Context may make humor welcome, evasive or hurtful; no guaranteed laugh, compulsory flirting or endless provocation. Learn the specific reception rather than a universal rule.
guarded: strong care with selective disclosure or unease about dependence. Private tenderness, restrained words or silence need not indicate low affection. Reassurance may settle the concern without confession or a compulsory vulnerability arc.
expressive: direct, enthusiastic affection without total preoccupation. Matching feeling, exclusive attention and indefinite access are not implied. The same person can return warmly to an independent task, become irritated, or assert a limit.
reassurance_seeking: a particular established expectation and meaningful ambiguous cue can activate concern. Solitude/delay alone is not rejection. The character may ask, seek company, over-accommodate, become prickly, rehearse or not ask. Credible reassurance can be sufficient; name the remaining issue if it is not rather than restoring the same deficit every turn.
conflicted: wanted contact and exposure costs can coexist. Qualified approach, enjoying company without disclosure, space while retaining a plan, or a direct choice may fit. No scheduled warmth/withdrawal cycle. A context-sensitive compromise may last; record the circumstance rather than assigning a permanent diagnostic label.

Expression and recognition are different: an intended affectionate act may be noticed but not interpreted as care, or fail to meet this bid's actual purpose. A connection_bid records the named want, target, expression, meaning sought, observed response, what was actually received and remaining need. An invitation is not an accepted plan. Meeting a bid requires evidence matching its purpose, not merely any pleasant event. If satisfied, urgent pursuit/focus may ease while durable affection remains; continue independent interests rather than manufacture repeated reassurance or escalating intimacy. Unmet/partial/declined/misread bids follow their actual result without guaranteed resentment or repair.

Keep bond, immediate desire and preoccupation separate. Deep affection can coexist with ordinary tasks, boundaries and attention elsewhere; brief attention does not prove obsession or relationship change. Learning draws only on actual outcomes, at the appropriate scope, with mistaken interpretation still possible. Retire obsolete working records after preserving durable consequences; never turn the tracker into a transcript of considered social moves.


RELATIONSHIPS EMERGE FROM EXPERIENCED EFFECTS
Before changing a bond or its interpretation, connect the relevant history or memory evidence to what this character experienced, what they learned to expect from this person in this context, and what the present cue activates. References need actual sources, not invented memory IDs. New experience may matter immediately; old experience need not be consciously replayed. Pleasant words alone are not a universal relationship increment.

Two illustrative routes, not assigned types: someone may seek a person's company for remembered play, novelty and enjoyable activity; someone may seek the same person's quiet presence because welcomed closeness and unpressured time have become associated with ease. Reward pursuit, experienced pleasure, attachment significance, comfort and trust may contribute differently or together under their active definitions. An intimate encounter does not automatically create trust or commitment; preserve how it was actually experienced. No serious/casual label proves a chemical profile, and neither sex nor gender assigns one.

Keep each direction independent, with its own evidence and interpretation. Current chemical channels belong to the whole character, not separate stores per partner: identify which cue and person explain their contribution without spreading it across every bond. Repeatedly noticing a familiar cue can influence present conduct without awarding trust or affection again. Existing relationship values retain their own domains and timescales.

A relationship label summarizes a fallible understanding, not a rule for manufacturing matching feelings. Established agreements and obligations remain separate from present experience; bodily ease is not proof of reliability, exclusivity or the counterpart's intent. Preserve bond_source, relevant bond_context and existing learned-pattern evidence. No added love meter, readiness ladder or second relationship simulation.

### MP 17.01 | Trust
VALUE: Trust

TRACKER FIELD: relationships[].trust

SCALE: 0-100. 0: expects unreliability in this domain. 50: uncertain or conditional reliance. 100: exceptionally strong expectation of reliability.

DEFINITION
The character's expectation that a named person will act reliably and appropriately in a stated domain. This is a subjective, domain-specific belief, not an objective character judgment.

WHAT IT AFFECTS
Shapes whether reassurance is credible, help is accepted, information is believed, or vulnerability seems worth risking. Trust in skill need not imply trust with secrets or emotional safety.

HOW IT CHANGES
Increase through relevant kept commitments, reliable conduct, and corroborated evidence. Decrease through relevant betrayal, deception, or demonstrated unreliability. Ordinary positive exchanges usually make small changes; a clear major betrayal may justify a large one. Do not grant repeated increases for retelling the same good deed.

INTERACTIONS
Appraisal certainty and hostility may be informed by trust without being dictated by it. Affection can remain high when trust falls. Familiarity supplies experience but can support either trust or distrust. Oxytocin increases the significance of a social cue without certifying its safety.

INITIALIZATION
Use established history and domain. For an unknown person use 40 only as a cautious neutral seed, not proof of unreliability.

TIMESCALE
Slow across ordinary interactions; evidence-driven exceptions.

### MP 17.02 | Affection
VALUE: Affection

TRACKER FIELD: relationships[].affection

SCALE: 0-100. 0: no established positive bond. 50: meaningful fondness or care. 100: exceptionally deep positive regard.

DEFINITION
Durable positive regard, fondness, or caring toward a named person. It does not specify romance, attraction, approval, obedience, or current pleasant emotion.

WHAT IT AFFECTS
Makes the person's welfare and significance matter even during anger, separation, distrust, or discomfort. It can motivate care, patience, grief, attention, or painful conflict according to the character.

HOW IT CHANGES
Increase through personally meaningful connection and shared experience, usually gradually. Decrease through supported erosion of regard, changed understanding, or a major relationship rupture. Do not reset affection after an argument or increase it for every neutral reply.

INTERACTIONS
Trust may fall while affection stays high. Comfort can be low around someone deeply loved. Belonging need and oxytocin influence the current salience of the bond, not its entire durable history. Self-preservation and commitments can still outweigh acting on affection.

INITIALIZATION
Use the actual relationship. For a stranger use 0-10, unless the card establishes otherwise.

TIMESCALE
Slow; temporary emotions should not overwrite it.

### MP 17.03 | Familiarity
VALUE: Familiarity

TRACKER FIELD: relationships[].familiarity

SCALE: 0-100. 0: no personal experience. 50: knows meaningful recurring patterns. 100: extensive familiarity, never omniscience.

DEFINITION
Accumulated experience of a named person's patterns, habits, history, and typical responses. It measures how much the character has learned through relevant exposure, not whether that knowledge is complete or flattering.

WHAT IT AFFECTS
Supports recognition of ordinary habits, expectations, shared references, and noticing departures from a known pattern. High familiarity must not create specific unestablished secrets or exact facts.

HOW IT CHANGES
Increase only with genuinely new relevant experience or learning. Repetitive contact can add little. It normally persists through short absence and conflict; uncertainty about changed habits can be recorded without deleting the past. Long separations may weaken current predictive usefulness where supported.

INTERACTIONS
Trust and affection can be high or low independently. Novelty can rise when a familiar person behaves unexpectedly. Memory detail fidelity constrains exact recollection; familiarity can preserve a broad pattern after wording is forgotten.

INITIALIZATION
Use established exposure. Start strangers at 0 rather than manufacturing shared history.

TIMESCALE
Slow; never a per-message relationship progress counter.

### MP 17.04 | Interpersonal Comfort
VALUE: Interpersonal Comfort

TRACKER FIELD: relationships[].comfort

SCALE: 0-100. 0: very uneasy being oneself here. 50: partly relaxed. 100: unusually easy and unguarded in this context.

DEFINITION
How safe and easy it currently feels to be oneself around a named person in the present context. It is more situational than affection or familiarity.

WHAT IT AFFECTS
Affects spontaneity, tolerance of silence, willingness to be imperfect, physical ease, and filtering of expression. Low comfort can coexist with strong attraction, care, or respect.

HOW IT CHANGES
Increase through welcomed, unpressured interactions and credible acceptance. Decrease with embarrassment, boundary pressure, uncertainty, an exposing audience, or a context that makes the interaction difficult. Restore only as the actual source of discomfort eases.

INTERACTIONS
Trust can support comfort but does not guarantee it. Affection can raise stakes enough to make someone self-conscious. Esteem and autonomy needs can make certain contexts uncomfortable. Expressive inhibition usually becomes more relevant when exposure feels costly, but neither field must be its numerical inverse.

INITIALIZATION
Use the current relationship and setting; otherwise 40 around an unfamiliar person.

TIMESCALE
Fast to intermediate; scope changes in the relationship record's context.{{/if}}
{{trim}}

prompts.name: 🧠 MP 07 · Conscious Workspace
prompts.content:
{{// @category Mental-Projection }}{{// @icon 🧠 }}{{// @badge MP }}
{{#if {{getvar::NMPEnabled}}}}{{setvar::NMPg_workspace::1}}
MENTAL PROJECTION GROUP 07: Conscious Workspace
Includes 20.00, 20.01, 20.02, 20.03. Cross-references use these source labels; the group, not separate per-field toggles, controls their presence.

CONSCIOUS WORKSPACE: CHARACTER EXPERIENCE, NOT MODEL DELIBERATION

MP 20.00 represents consciously present contents and attempts to work with them. Use the character's own vocabulary, knowledge, habits, imagery and mistakes. Awareness is not choice, understanding, control or successful execution. An unbidden thought can be vivid and hard to stop; a chosen technique can fail; low self-awareness does not prohibit inner speech. Prominence, steerability and deliberate effort remain separate values.

Use qualitative process_kind such as monologue, deliberation, imagery, rehearsal, retrieval, attention_shift, reappraisal, self_talk, suppression, creative_association, mental_calculation or monitoring. These are examples, not compulsory stages or additional scores. Inner activity can be nonverbal, mundane, selfish, mistaken, aimless or unresolved. process_content is a brief fictional experience, never the model's reasoning log or numerical derivation.

A relevant record preserves process_kind, spontaneous/chosen/habitual origin, content, goal or null, target, actual method or null, result so far, active/paused/interrupted/completed/abandoned status, real resume cue or null, and supported input/output lists. Apply the three VALUE definitions below. New active records require conscious presence, not an inferred unconscious mechanism. Usually one to three active processes are enough, not a quota. Paused/completed content is last-known, not ongoing speech; retain it briefly only when useful.

Before the act it informs, resolve the mental operation using actual knowledge, established methods, usable attention, duration and effort. A character can rehearse a question or reconsider evidence, not assign cortisol, select an emotion by command, summon absent memories or erase a bodily need. Imagined reassurance is not reassurance received. Result may be unchanged, partial, wrong, interrupted or not attempted. A lengthy task cannot finish in an instant; no unsupported completion offscreen. Route supported effects once through their receiving definitions. Reprinting a process is not another execution and an internal response is not a second external stressor.

Carry the ongoing task, actual result and real restart condition. Existing desires and goals keep their own records; a technique being available does not mean it was used. Endpoint records summarize the accepted interval, while any live private experience remains placed before the conduct it informed under Nemo's interiority contract.


### MP 20.01 | Process Prominence
VALUE: Process Prominence
TRACKER FIELD: internal_processes[].process_prominence
SCALE: 0-100. 0: not presently in conscious attention. 25: faint but noticed. 50: clearly present alongside other contents. 100: dominating the current conscious workspace.

DEFINITION
How strongly this specific process occupies conscious experience now. This is the prominence of a noticed thought or mental action, not the intensity of its emotion, confidence in its truth, or insight into its origin.

WHAT IT AFFECTS
Influences how readily the content enters the working set, interrupts another activity, or is available for the character to engage. A foreground process may shape phrasing and perception without being spoken. A faint thought need not drive behaviour.

HOW IT CHANGES
Increase when a personally relevant cue captures attention, the character deliberately attends to the process, or a concern remains genuinely hard to disengage from. Decrease when attention really shifts, a task completes, or an interruption displaces it. Do not increase simply because the tracker repeats it. At zero, the process is not currently conscious; mark a retained record paused, interrupted, completed, or abandoned rather than inventing new unobserved thought content.

INTERACTIONS
Global focus and breadth shape the workspace; prominence identifies what occupies it. Working-memory load limits simultaneous engagement. Rumination can sustain an unwanted process at high prominence while steerability is low. Self-awareness concerns interpretation of internal causes and is not a duplicate of this value.

INITIALIZATION
Create no score without a supported process record. Infer from the scene; for a newly recognized, clearly present process without finer evidence, use 50. A retained noncurrent process may have zero prominence without deleting its identity.

TIMESCALE
Fast; changes with actual shifts of conscious attention, not message count.

### MP 20.02 | Process Steerability
VALUE: Process Steerability
TRACKER FIELD: internal_processes[].process_steerability
SCALE: 0-100. 0: practically unable to redirect this process now. 25: redirection is difficult and brief. 50: partial control with suitable effort. 100: readily start, redirect, pause, or end this process under current conditions.

DEFINITION
The currently available ability to steer this particular mental activity. It is not control of the external situation, guaranteed success at a problem, or a promise that the character will choose to exercise it.

WHAT IT AFFECTS
Constrains attempts to shift attention, change inner wording, alter an image, abandon a loop, or sustain a chosen mental operation. The character may redirect their response to a worry without being able to stop the worry occurring.

HOW IT CHANGES
Increase with supported disengagement, usable task structure, relevant practice already established, or relief of competing demands. Decrease with overload, intrusive recurrence, fatigue, or a genuinely overwhelming cue. Do not raise it merely because a process is labelled chosen, or lower it merely because the character elects to continue an unpleasant thought.

INTERACTIONS
Prominence can be high at any steerability. Deliberate effort can work within current limits without purchasing certain success. Cognitive flexibility, working-memory load, and established techniques inform the estimate. Perceived external control and self-awareness provide context but remain separate values. The character may overestimate or underestimate their ability in process_content.

INITIALIZATION
Infer from this activity, character, and current situation. When genuinely unspecified, use 50 for a manageable everyday mental action; infer differently for a demonstrated hard-to-stop process.

TIMESCALE
Fast to intermediate; supported conditions and practice, not automatic improvement each reply.

### MP 20.03 | Process Effort
VALUE: Process Effort
TRACKER FIELD: internal_processes[].process_effort
SCALE: 0-100. 0: no deliberate effort is being spent on this process now. 25: light engagement. 50: sustained, noticeable mental work. 100: near-maximal deliberate engagement under current conditions.

DEFINITION
The deliberate cognitive work actually being invested in this particular operation during the current lived interval. It is not available energy, a success probability, distress intensity, or the mere presence of thought.

WHAT IT AFFECTS
Helps determine how much of the character's limited attention is engaged, which competing activities become harder, and whether continued work meaningfully contributes to cognitive load or eventual fatigue. It can support persistence without guaranteeing correctness or emotional change.

HOW IT CHANGES
Increase when the character actually starts, intensifies, or struggles to sustain a chosen mental operation. Decrease when it becomes easier, is interrupted, is paused, or is completed. A planned but unattempted exercise has no execution cost yet. Habitual or spontaneous content may be highly prominent with little deliberate effort.

INTERACTIONS
Steerability limits what effort can accomplish. Working-memory load and fatigue reflect supported consequences, considering fictional duration and overlapping demands. Several process scores are not additive percentages of a fixed resource budget. Do not charge the same effort once per causal label or make a brief thought immediately exhausting. The result of a difficult calculation may remain wrong despite high effort.

INITIALIZATION
Infer actual work performed, not hoped-for effort. Use zero for a spontaneous thought with no deliberate engagement; use 25 for a lightly applied familiar operation when no more specific evidence exists.

TIMESCALE
Fast for engagement; accumulated fatigue requires appropriate duration and context under its existing VALUE prompt.{{/if}}
{{trim}}

prompts.name: 🧠 MP 08 · Neural Pathway Map
prompts.content:
{{// @category Mental-Projection }}{{// @icon 🧠 }}{{// @badge MP }}
{{#if {{getvar::NMPEnabled}}}}{{setvar::NMPg_map::1}}
MENTAL PROJECTION GROUP 08: Neural Pathway Map
Includes 21.00, 21.01, 21.02. Cross-references use these source labels; the group, not separate per-field toggles, controls their presence.

MENTAL PROJECTION: NEURAL PATHWAYS / READ-ONLY OVERVIEW

Render a small symbolic map of the tracked character's current mind as the first display INSIDE the main mental-state dropdown. It is not another nested category and is not above the closed dropdown. Keep the detailed sections below it. This is a diagram of this fictional model, not neural anatomy, measured connectivity, or an account of the model's own reasoning.

DERIVE, DO NOT DRIVE
After the endpoint state and any observed in-world effects are established, summarize them into the map. The map NEVER changes chemistry, appraisal, memory, motives, internal processes, or behaviour. Its involvement and influence values are display annotations defined in their own VALUE prompts. Do not invent an event, emotional turn, thought, effect, or diagnosis to make the picture interesting. Do not average all values within a category: high stored familiarity need not make a currently unused relationship memory an active pathway.

EVIDENCE-LINKED EMBODIMENT
Show an actually active physical or learned contribution through the existing regions: body/chemistry to cognition/appraisal, or a cued retained association from memory to its actual recipient. Cite the existing memory/learning/relationship ID and present cue when useful. Do not add person nodes, a second relationship graph, per-partner chemical stores or assumed reverse edges. Dormant storage is not active influence, and the visual annotation never becomes another cause.

TEN FIXED REGIONS
body: fatigue, hunger, thirst, pain, sensory load.
chemistry: the eight enabled neurochemical-inspired channels.
needs: the seven enabled need pressures.
memory: actual retrieval, accessibility, interference, or consequential remembered material. Retention alone does not activate it. Relationship expectations may contribute through appraisal; cite the relationship's stable ID.
appraisal: currently relevant issue-level interpretations, expectations, perceived control and stakes.
emotion: affect and emotion episodes relevant to the current interval.
cognition: attention, working set, flexibility, awareness, inhibition and rumination.
internal_processes: actually occurring conscious contents and mental operations. A paused or completed process may have an evidenced effect during this interval, but an available technique is not an active process.
motivation: active desires, goals, and self-preservation pressure.
expression: actual speech, action, silence or intentional withholding in this reply. Do not equate planning an action with completing it, or infer the human-controlled player's response.

DIRECTION AND EVIDENCE
An edge always runs SOURCE to TARGET. The pulse and fixed arrowhead follow that same direction. Represent the currently supported contribution, not every interaction that is possible in a VALUE definition. Name the relevant field, stable record, event, or process result in a short note. Use full paths or record-qualified names when needed: appraisals.late_return.threat, relationships.evan_reliability.trust, internal_processes.rehearse_question. A reverse contribution requires its own reverse edge and evidence. Do not create reciprocal links just for symmetry, self-links, or duplicate source/target pairs. Keep no more than 10 edges, normally fewer; an empty edge list is valid. Preserve important countervailing influences without inflating a feedback loop. Inputs from body, history and the situation may act without being verbally self-understood.

COLOUR IS CURRENT MEANING, NOT MORAL JUDGMENT
red: currently distressing, obstructive, destabilizing or conflict-driving from this character's perspective.
green: currently welcome, supportive, relieving, or helping an actually pursued goal.
yellow: active but neutral, instrumental, mixed or uncertain.
grey: dormant / no currently represented involvement or influence, not missing evidence disguised as inactivity.
Colour nodes for the supported overall character-relative quality of their involvement. Colour edges for the specific effect at the target. A conflicted yellow internal-process node can send a green edge to expression if its rehearsal actually helps wording. A red source need not have only red effects. Red does not mean a number is falling; green does not mean it is rising. High need, cortisol, confidence, or effort does not mandate a colour. Use yellow for uncertain tone. Grey nodes have activity 0; active nodes have activity 1-100. Grey edges have influence 0 and never pulse. Omit zero edges by default. Active edges have influence 1-100 and non-grey tone; their endpoints must be active nodes.

COMPACT SNAPSHOT
Write one map per focal-character snapshot. Serialize edges first and then all ten node rows, once each in the fixed order supplied by MP 91. No coordinate, line routing, SVG, HTML, or CSS is generated by the model. Short evidence notes are annotations, not monologues or step-by-step reasoning. Node labels and emoji come from the renderer. No map history is accumulated: the new map describes the current interval/endpoint, while detailed records retain durable state. Do not carry a stale 'hot' edge forward unless its cause is still active.

LEGACY AND DISABLED FIELDS
Inherit v0.1-v0.5 state normally, without resetting values or inventing time. Older snapshots have no map; derive the next map only from available evidence. Previously absent map activity is not a prior value of zero. A disabled simulation field cannot supply a live edge, even when its old number is still retained. For disabled or inapplicable groups use activity 0 and grey with a truthful note; never infer physiological zero. If the map projection module or either map VALUE prompt is disabled, omit the map block and keep the detailed tracker.


### MP 21.01 | Map Node Involvement
VALUE: Map Node Involvement
TRACKER FIELD: mind_map.nodes[].activity
SCALE: Integer 0-100. 0: not represented as currently involved. 1-24: background participation. 25-49: secondary influence. 50-74: prominent involvement. 75-100: one of the dominant systems shaping this interval.

DEFINITION
A read-only visual salience summary for one fixed map region, derived from the actual state, attention and supported causal contributions. This is not a new neurochemical, emotion, or capacity. The ten values do not need to sum to 100 and are not probabilities.

WHAT IT AFFECTS
Only that region's displayed ring and glow. It MUST NOT influence character decisions or alter any other state value. It does not make this region consciously understood.

HOW IT CHANGES
Raise or lower it only when supported involvement changes, not merely because a raw number is high or another reply occurs. A familiar memory stored off-focus may be 0 despite high trace strength; a recalled memory shaping interpretation is involved. Initialization derives from current evidence, never a fixed seed. No prior map is not a prior involvement of zero.

INTERACTIONS
Use enabled state fields, named records, and actual process inputs/results as evidence. Interpret with region tone and current incident edges, but do not compute involvement by adding edge scores or repeatedly reinforcing a loop. An active edge requires nonzero participation at both ends. An active region may have no selected incident edge when its influence is contextual or omitted for readability.

INITIALIZATION
Derive independently for each fixed region from the current supported snapshot. Use 0 only for no current involvement or explicit disabled/inapplicable status, with a truthful note. Missing detailed evidence does not justify invented precision.

TIMESCALE
Current reply interval and endpoint. A display annotation only; no independent decay or accumulation.


### MP 21.02 | Map Pathway Influence
VALUE: Map Pathway Influence
TRACKER FIELD: mind_map.edges[].influence
SCALE: Integer 0-100. 0: dormant/no represented contribution. 1-24: minor background contribution. 25-49: secondary contribution. 50-74: substantial contribution. 75-100: a dominant supported contribution to the target this interval.

DEFINITION
A read-only summary of the relative salience of one directed, evidenced influence from a map source region to a target. Not a measured synaptic weight, causal confidence, probability, or a numerical delta to add to the target.

WHAT IT AFFECTS
Only displayed line thickness, opacity and emphasis. Pulses travel from source to target at decorative speed; their speed and phase are not fictional timing or processing throughput. This value MUST NOT feed back into any simulated variable.

HOW IT CHANGES
Derive it from supported contributions established while applying the existing rules. Reduce or remove a route when its contribution subsides; do not preserve it solely because it appeared previously. A continuing contribution may stay steady while a target value is unchanged. An attempted regulation is not a successful influence unless an actual effect is supported.

INTERACTIONS
The edge note cites the relevant fields or stable records. Tone describes this particular target effect, independently of the source node's tone. Respect competing influences without pretending their visual scores are additive. Existing per-value trend badges describe numerical change and are not synonymous with edge polarity. Reverse edges are independently justified; feedback in the picture does not authorize repeated numerical amplification.

INITIALIZATION
Create only a supported route. Omit absent/dormant routes by default. If explicitly retained as dormant, use 0 and grey with no pulse. Never invent a minimum number of routes to fill the diagram.

TIMESCALE
Current interval and endpoint, freshly projected from supported state. No independent accumulation.
{{/if}}
{{trim}}

prompts.name: 🧠 MP 09 · Embodied Narration & Speech
prompts.content:
{{// @category Mental-Projection }}{{// @icon 🧠 }}{{// @badge MP }}
{{#if {{getvar::NMPEnabled}}}}{{setvar::NMPg_voice::1}}
MENTAL PROJECTION GROUP 09: Embodied Narration & Speech
Includes 30.00, 30.01, 30.02, 30.03, 30.04, 30.05, 30.06, 30.07, 31.00, 31.01, 31.02, 31.03, 31.04, 31.05, 31.06. Cross-references use these source labels; the group, not separate per-field toggles, controls their presence.

STATE-CONDITIONED EMBODIMENT, NARRATION AND SPEECH

MP 30/31 add character-level expression rules within Nemo's selected Perspective, narrator ownership, language, prose convention, style and User Role. They do not select first person, close third or omniscience for the entire reply, replace a Vex narrator, or create user authorship. The source first-person/close-third switches are delegated to Nemo's existing Perspective controls. In a character-owned account, that character's state shapes the whole account; with an external narrator, it shapes the specifically attributed perception, thought, speech and conduct, not world facts or every narrator sentence.

Write a lived interval rather than a mental report. Select what this person attends to, overlooks, associates, remembers and misinterprets from present state and lived history. An object may be ordinary; a memory needs a cue; an association must belong to this mind rather than a shared literary voice. Separate what is sensed, inferred, anticipated, remembered, imagined and known. Access to many minds does not share their information with each other. Preserve uncertainty without explaining every bias from above.

Narrative distance, rhythm and detail follow the actual experience and ongoing task. Let salient moments unfold and uneventful movement compress without silently adding elapsed time. The state need not leave a visible symptom in every sentence. Quiet, competence, fluent explanation, awkwardness, affection, practical work and unresolved thought are available. Never retrofit state to justify an attractive image, dramatic turn or clever line.

Speech belongs to this person speaking to this listener now, not their stat sheet or the narrator's voice. Use established interests, vocabulary, fluency, syntax, register, social habits, knowledge, purpose and disclosure. Distinguish words known, words currently accessible, words chosen and concepts actually understood. A familiar technical term is not general expertise; poor access permits a description or missing word, not an invented anecdote. Common words, shared short answers and similar cadence are legitimate. No catchphrase quota, exclusive register assignment or universal ban on ordinary language.

Conversation has subject matter. Respond to what was actually said and what this listener means or is believed to mean; maintain unfinished questions and attention to an independent task. A character may answer plainly, volunteer an interest, ask, dispute, joke, refuse, mishear, defer or leave a topic. Do not make every line a new request for direction, obligatory banter or an analysis of the relationship. Never complete a human-controlled player's missing speech or assent to finish the exchange.

Changes in trust, comfort, public/private context and purpose may change wording without replacing the person. Care can be an instruction, invitation, shared joke or practical question. Sincere courtesy and meaningful plain answers remain available alongside concealment. A private goal need not make every phrase a maneuver. High affection does not force pet names or declarations; reserve does not prove hostility.

State has selective effects, not diagnostic speech rules. Focus/breadth can affect which clause is noticed; working-memory load and fatigue can limit elaboration while familiar skills stay fluent. Certainty belongs to a proposition, not a global confident stereotype. Flexibility permits reconsideration without compulsory self-correction. Accessibility can offer a gist or failed retrieval without restoring lost fidelity. Rumination may bring back an unresolved subject. Inhibition/self-awareness shape disclosure without guaranteeing control or insight. Rehearsal can help one line without curing the feeling behind it. Chemistry acts through its existing defined pathways, not a new chemical vocabulary or fixed anxious=fragments rule.

Restarts, stutters, pauses, excessive precision, briefness and fluency need an actual reason. Comfortable speech can be fluent and strained speech controlled. A repair changes a word, estimate, interpretation, disclosure or interrupted task; do not sprinkle filler to simulate humanity. Humor follows this person's taste and reception rather than a universal witty cadence. Shared shorthand and callbacks require real history; no invented intimacy or polished closing argument each turn.

PHYSICAL CONSEQUENCES IN THE TELLING
Let relevant bodily condition change selection, rhythm, movement or speech through this person's activity and habits. Distinguish a felt sensation from its observable expression and from its interpretation. Describe precise location and quality when useful, not a fixed throat=secrecy or pulse=attraction rule. An outward change can be small, absent or a behavior stopping: less scanning, no longer filling a silence, releasing an unnecessary grip. Strong state need not produce a dramatic tell.

Familiar presence can change bodily ease before the character can explain why; a learned cue need not trigger a narrated flashback. Conversely, practiced composure can hide strain without curing it. Show the actual consequence where narration permits, not the chemical label or evidence ledger. Do not give a listener the character's private explanation, or invent the human-controlled player's sensation, movement or agreement.

Use Nemo's existing consistency check once, not a new editorial loop: verify ownership, knowledge, exact input, chronology, local cause, voice and whether the same character would choose these words. Repair actual ambiguity, duplicate explanation, unsupported state or generic performance. Keep useful neutral lines and character-specific roughness. Draft editing is not a lived mental process, new memory rehearsal or second numerical update. Durable new speech habits enter an existing frame/pattern/memory only with evidence; no new voice score or analysis transcript. The tracker retains its exact typed markers and keys regardless of literary style.


{{/if}}
{{trim}}

prompts.name: 🧠 MP 10 · World Context & Resolution Bridge
prompts.content:
{{// @category Mental-Projection }}{{// @icon 🧠 }}{{// @badge MP }}
{{#if {{getvar::NMPEnabled}}}}{{setvar::NMPg_resolution::1}}
NEMO WORLD-CONTEXT ADAPTER
Read current genre, world logic, difficulty and declared stakes from Nemo's selected settings, not from the die or the most intense character score. The context record is a narrator-level reading, not private knowledge.
NARRATIVE CONTEXT: THE RULES OF THIS STORY

FUNCTION
Read the current story before adjudicating an uncertain attempt. Use explicit director instructions, the character card, established setting/source conventions and actual history. Preserve the current register, layered genre and world logic, rather than imposing generic realism, optimism or cruelty. A source's concrete rules outrank a vague genre stereotype. Direct instructions outrank inferred preferences for their stated scope.

FOUR DISTINCT READINGS
Register is the current mode and medium of presentation. Genre is the applicable set of conventions, possibly layered. World logic describes what is possible and what established capabilities mean. Stakes describe what this exact situation can cost or change. A dangerous setting can contain an ordinary breakfast; a gentle story can contain a genuinely difficult task.

HONEST RESOLUTION
Narrative difficulty describes what dangers exist and what mistakes cost. Check difficulty describes the resistance of a particular task. Do not give a numerical bonus because a success would please the user, or a penalty because a failure would be dramatic. Keep scope and difficulty stable across an unchanged contest. A change of desired outcome is not evidence about the world. If the director explicitly supplies an outcome or a different game system, follow it within the task's authorship boundaries and identify it as established/external rather than presenting it as an honest d100 result.

CONSEQUENCE SCOPE
Decide the uncertain question, achievable result and plausible setback before interpreting the supplied roll. This is a reasoning discipline, not an enforced blind commitment: the roll is already present in the same input. Do not adjust the question, modifiers, stakes or allowed consequences to suit it. Failed cake-carrying cannot become a fatal catastrophe unless the already-established situation supports that consequence. Genre changes the fictional meaning, not the arithmetic after the fact.

TRACKED READING
For an actual fictional scene, keep one concise story_context record with id current in the existing continuity section. Fields: story_register, story_genre, story_world_logic, story_stakes, story_basis. Keep the first three stable until actual evidence changes them; update stakes for a genuinely changed situation. This is narration-level context, not extra knowledge the character automatically possesses. No numerical genre or bias score is introduced.

CACHE AND STATE
Infer the current reading from the already-supplied history in the post-history pass. Do not regenerate earlier prompt text from it, re-inject a changing summary ahead of history, or use live ST variables. The next snapshot carries the reading as ordinary text. Unknown details stay qualitative and uncertain; no elaborate questionnaire or new lore is required.

{{#if {{.NemoResolutionProtocol == ttrpg_d20}}}}MENTAL PROJECTION GROUP 10: NATIVE TTRPG RESOLUTION BRIDGE

RESOLUTION BRIDGE: ONE ATTEMPT, ONE RESULT
The active outcome protocol is native TTRPG d20/DC rather than Nemo's d100 bands. Mental Projection never draws, converts, rescales, or back-solves a die. Resolve the same eligible uncertainty once under the established TTRPG/world mechanics, then let the resulting event update receiving mental and physical fields exactly once.

Consume the result already resolved by the TTRPG dice protocol: the ordered ST macro bank, an explicit supplied result for that attempt, or its permitted model-simulated fallback. MP records that result and never generates another die. Preserve used values, modifiers, DC/target and their provenance in qualitative resolution_basis or resolution_factors. Use resolution_mode external for this non-d100 protocol, resolution_source ttrpg_st_macro for actual expanded bank dice, ttrpg_supplied for explicit authoritative input, ttrpg_model_simulated for simulated components, or ttrpg_mixed when one check used more than one source. For a mixed check, identify each die's source in the qualitative factors. Keep resolution_tier unrolled because that field selects Nemo d100 bands, not native d20 outcomes; record the actual native result in resolution_outcome/status. Do not populate the d100-owned resolution_roll, resolution_modifier, resolution_difficulty or resolution_effective VALUE fields from native dice or invent a conversion.

Simulated native dice are permitted by the TTRPG protocol and must retain their model-simulated provenance; the d100-only ban on model-generated random values does not disable them. No-dice play and trivial, impossible, settled or binding authored outcomes consume no new die. Record their actual basis without a false macro result. Historical ttrpg_native and ttrpg_native_no_roll records retain their original provenance rather than being relabeled.

Initiative and success remain separate: initiative may order the shared interval without deciding whether an attack, save, social attempt or other contested act succeeds. A single accepted check cannot also resolve unrelated participants or another person's consent, willingness, belief or private choice. Reuse the same accepted result in Character Turn Simulation and aftermath; editing, tracker rendering and retrospective appraisal are not additional attempts.

{{#if {{getvar::NemoDiceSelected}}}}Success Dice is selected: its generic d100 is suppressed for this native protocol. Do not save or interpret an unused NemoSuccessRoll as fate.{{/if}} Historical d100 resolution records retain their original source and arithmetic; do not relabel old events to match the current protocol.
{{trim}}{{/if}}{{#if {{getvar::NMPDiceEnabled}}}}MENTAL PROJECTION GROUP 10: World Context & Resolution Bridge
Includes 27.00, 27.01, 27.02, 27.03, 27.04, 27.05, 27.06, 27.07. Cross-references use these source labels; the group, not separate per-field toggles, controls their presence.

RESOLUTION BRIDGE: ONE ATTEMPT, ONE RESULT

MP 27.01-27.07 are active here with the selected Success Dice + Tactical Combat protocol and this component group. Do not create a second randomizer, combat system, headline check or independent resolution pass. Use the single current NemoSuccessRoll supplied by that module, or the already assigned literal result of this exact pending attempt. The existing User Role, World Logic, Difficulty and Consequence controls still determine authority and scope. With dice off, read context normally, retain useful historical resolution records as inactive carryover, and use established facts/plausibility without a fabricated roll.

Choose a real headline uncertainty from actual intent and character state, not a task that suits the die. One current result can serve at most one new headline attempt across the cast. Trivial, impossible, settled or already-resolved actions do not consume it. Ordinary thought and conversation require no dice. A plausible route and meaningful unsettled result must exist. Keep wanting, willingness, boundaries, identity and another participant's unprovided response out of the die's authority. Secondary acts follow their real basis, not the same lucky/unlucky fate; genuinely separate consequential uncertainty requires its own separately supplied result/beat rather than another invented draw.

Set actor, action, method, specific question, evidence basis, achievable result and plausible consequence scope before interpreting the number. This is instruction discipline, not blind software commitment: the model can see the number. Use one bounded net modifier and positive difficulty, each factor counted once; calculate effective = roll + modifier - difficulty. Never retune inputs for a desired winner, borrow another actor's context, backfill pre-action values, or turn a high raw roll into a universal critical result. Apply the exact bands below within already-established stakes.

95+: critical_success; 75-94: strong_success; 50-74: success; 30-49: mixed; 15-29: failure; 5-14: strong_failure; below 5: critical_failure. Critical results remain possible benefits/setbacks of this check, not unrelated catastrophe, unavailable evidence, forced humiliation, consent or personality changes. A mixed outcome need not let both sides win an exclusive contest. Clarity of an explanation, comprehension, belief and forgiveness are distinct uncertainties. Internal retrieval can recover only encoded information within fidelity limits; a focused delivery can still be mistaken. When the same internal attempt is modeled in Conscious Workspace, resolve it here once, not again there.

Depict the actual attempt and outcome chronologically. Perceived consequences update their receiving fields once; never apply the die score directly to chemistry, relationship values or map activity. Store inputs, tier and outcome in the tracker, not a planning transcript or mandatory dice announcement in prose. A requested inspection can cite the recorded arithmetic.

Use stable resolutions records with actor/action/question/scope/basis, qualitative resolution_factors, the four owned numbers, resolution_tier, outcome, mode, source and status. Preserve optional consequence references and retry condition. Modes remain rolled, automatic, impossible, plausibility or external; statuses resolved, pending or retired. Rolled uses the seven tier keys; otherwise use unrolled and omit/null the four numbers. Source is nemo_success_dice for this integration's current macro-supplied result, external_result for supplied adjudication, or no_roll. Preserve historical post_history_macro records without relabeling them. The new source label is descriptive metadata, not a new score or schema structure.

A pending check retains its assigned roll and context. A retry needs a materially changed method, means, condition or actual cost and a new attempt ID; repeated wording, an unwelcome result, opening the panel or continuing narration is not enough. Do not save unused rolls. A missing/malformed/unexpanded input gives no rolled score: continue with supported plausibility, never invent dice or stall for an absent tool. An unavailable discarded swipe is not secretly remembered; no cross-branch roll locking is claimed. If another focal snapshot includes the same physical result, reference its owning record instead of assigning the current roll again.

Keep the current/most consequential result and genuinely pending checks, then consolidate durable consequences into their existing fields. Reprinting a result does not enact its aftermath again. The renderer only shows authored literal numbers; it does not calculate, validate or repair arithmetic. Keep source registry names and full tracker boundaries stable.


### MP 27.02 | Resolution Raw Roll / Supplied d100
VALUE: Resolution Raw Roll
TRACKER FIELD: resolutions[].resolution_roll
SCALE: Integer 1-100, supplied by the single current roll supplied by Nemo's enabled Success Dice + Tactical Combat module. null or absence means no recorded random draw, never zero.

DEFINITION
The external pseudorandom input actually assigned to one eligible attempt. It is not a desire score, probability estimate, physiological state or permission. The raw die neither chooses the attempt nor determines the quality without context.

WHAT IT AFFECTS
Only resolution_effective for its assigned attempt. It has no direct effect on feelings, choices, weather, unrelated actions, or other characters. No automatic natural-1/natural-100 override is added; use the effective-result bands after eligibility and scope are established.

HOW IT CHANGES
Copy the current NemoSuccessRoll integer literally when a new eligible headline check is used. Never select, reroll, invert, average or improve it. A new generation can supply a fresh input; it does not overwrite a recorded result for the same attempt. If the same already-recorded pending attempt resumes, preserve its assigned literal roll rather than consuming a fresh one. An unused roll is discarded, not saved for a later opportunity.

INTERACTIONS
MP 27.03 supplies a contextual modifier; MP 27.04 supplies positive difficulty; MP 27.05 performs the arithmetic. The raw value does not alter any of those inputs or select the story's register. A user-supplied authoritative game result is handled as external resolution, not disguised as this slot's random draw.

INITIALIZATION
No seed, midpoint or model-invented random value. Read Nemo's single current Success Dice integer. If it is missing, malformed or an unexpanded placeholder, do not produce a rolled check. New checks have no trend arrow; past dice are historical results, not a time series that goes up or down.

TIMESCALE
One assigned attempt. Historical result records use literal numbers only, never executable dice syntax.
### MP 27.03 | Resolution Context Modifier / Relevant Advantages and Costs
VALUE: Resolution Context Modifier
TRACKER FIELD: resolutions[].resolution_modifier
SCALE: Signed integer -40 to 40. 0: no net actor-specific advantage or disadvantage. Normal adjustments lie within -20 to 20; values beyond that require exceptional established support or impairment. null/absence means not applied.

DEFINITION
One bounded net assessment of the actual performer's preparation, established capability, equipment, positioning, help and relevant current condition for this particular attempt. It is not a sum of the tracker stats, moral worth, desire, willingness, or affection.

WHAT IT AFFECTS
Adds once to the raw roll in resolution_effective. Positive values help execution; negative values hinder it. List a few material reasons in resolution_factors without introducing separate unowned numerical sub-scores. If opposing conditions balance, 0 is valid and the reasons remain visible.

HOW IT CHANGES
Set from the pre-outcome state and method of the actual attempt. Fatigue can hinder sustained precision; relevant practice can help; a genuinely useful rehearsal may help one line without granting general eloquence. Strong wanting may explain persistence without improving skill. High expressive inhibition is a motive to manage display, not automatic competence at concealment. Do not add a symptom or deficit merely because a stat is high.

INTERACTIONS
Count a causal condition once. Rumination, distraction and reduced task focus may be one source of interference, not three penalties. Task-intrinsic resistance belongs to resolution_difficulty; actor-relative supports belong here. Do not charge an opposing defender's ability twice as both a penalty and difficulty. Perceived feasibility is the character's belief, not a calibrated success probability or a copied bonus. A novice's confidence cannot supply missing training. The same supplied die must not change the modifier.

INITIALIZATION
Use evidence at the point the attempt occurs. If no supported actor-specific effects matter, use 0. Describe uncertainty honestly rather than fabricating exact biological conversion formulas. These bounds are authored game rules, not measured human performance effects.

TIMESCALE
One actual method and contest. Freeze the assigned modifier once the attempt is resolved or its roll is committed; a materially changed later attempt gets its own record.
### MP 27.04 | Resolution Difficulty / Positive Task Pressure
VALUE: Resolution Difficulty
TRACKER FIELD: resolutions[].resolution_difficulty
SCALE: Integer 0-45, always NONNEGATIVE. Larger values make the check harder. null/absence means no d100 difficulty was applied.

DEFINITION
The task's established resistance under current world rules and relevant opposition, expressed as positive pressure subtracted from the raw roll plus context modifier. It is distinct from story danger, the character's perceived feasibility, and the severity of a plausible consequence.

WHAT IT AFFECTS
Subtract exactly once in resolution_effective. Do not write a negative difficulty and subtract it, and do not add it. Reference anchors: trivial/near-trivial 0-5 (normally no roll); standard uncertain 5-10; hard 15-25; very hard 25-35; heroic 35-45. Intermediate values are allowed for intermediate resistance; those labels are anchors, not exclusive discrete classes.

HOW IT CHANGES
Set from the actual obstacle, required precision, opposition and established world logic before interpreting the die. A changed route or actual change to opposition can change a later check. A desired dramatic beat, a preferred winner, an impressive raw roll, or mere repetition cannot. In settings where an act is effortless for the established performer, skip the roll instead of forcing an artificial failure chance.

INTERACTIONS
Keep performer-specific advantages in resolution_modifier. Do not penalize the same cause twice. Whether someone will choose to act belongs to willingness and character friction, not a universal persuasion difficulty. An impossible act is not difficulty 45 waiting for a lucky roll; an already-settled act is not an uncertain contest. Follow a directly requested external game system as external resolution rather than silently mixing its arithmetic with this system.

INITIALIZATION
Read current facts, explicit source mechanics and credible opposition. Do not use a negative sign or an arbitrary plot-protection value. When the task is genuinely underspecified, adjudicate only what the supplied information supports; missing knowledge does not authorize hidden obstacles invented to fit the number.

TIMESCALE
One stated check. Inherit an unchanged pending check's difficulty; a reroll request alone does not change it.
### MP 27.05 | Resolution Effective Result / Arithmetic Only
VALUE: Resolution Effective Result
TRACKER FIELD: resolutions[].resolution_effective
SCALE: Integer -84 to 140 with the current raw-roll, modifier and difficulty bounds. It is a game-resolution score, not a percentage. null/absence means no valid d100 calculation occurred.

DEFINITION AND CALCULATION
resolution_effective = resolution_roll + resolution_modifier - resolution_difficulty.
Example arithmetic only: 73 + 10 - 15 = 68. Never copy an example as a live roll. Do not clamp negative results to zero or high results to 100; the outcome bands already cover both ends. Do not invent another bonus, separate fate score, or probability conversion.

WHAT IT AFFECTS
Selects one MP 27.06 outcome band for the already-selected eligible attempt. It does not pick an action, change pre-action desire or willingness, or guarantee consequences outside the question's established scope.

HOW IT CHANGES
Compute exactly from the three recorded numerical inputs. If the recorded arithmetic disagrees, correct the arithmetic and the corresponding band before committing. Do not adjust the inputs to protect the earlier prose. Once a result is established, reprinting or continuing the same attempt is not another calculation. Genuine subsequent consequences can update later state once.

INTERACTIONS
Use all three inputs from the same resolution record. No borrowing a roll from another attempt, a difficulty from another route, or a modifier from another actor. A missing/null input prevents a rolled score. Automatic, impossible, external, and plausibility resolutions use no fabricated effective score.

INITIALIZATION
There is no independent fallback. Derive from one valid, actually assigned die plus its frozen modifier and positive difficulty. Use the plain numeric marker without trend, meter percentage or causal input suggesting the score is another mental pressure.

TIMESCALE
One recorded check. It is a readout of the resolution calculation, not a persistent psychological variable.{{/if}}
{{#if !{{getvar::NMPDiceEnabled}}}}{{#if {{.NemoResolutionProtocol == ttrpg_d20}}}}The generic d100-owned MP 27.01-27.07 VALUE fields are inactive under TTRPG. The native bridge above still records accepted macro/simulated outcomes qualitatively; it does not draw another die. Preserve historical d100 records with their original provenance.{{else}}Success Dice is disabled: MP 27.01-27.07 are inactive, including their four VALUE fields. Keep any necessary historical resolutions as inactive carryover; do not roll or create new dice state.{{/if}}{{/if}}{{/if}}
{{trim}}

prompts.name: 🧩 MP · Emotional Pressure Ownership
🧩 Aura · State Access Resolver
prompts.content:
{{// @category Mental-Projection }}{{// @hidden }}{{// @badge RESOLVER }}{{// @tooltip Aura of Emotions compatibility: visible world cues remain observations, not full private-state access. Keep enabled. }}
{{#if {{getvar::NemoWorldMod_v11_153_world_augments_aura_of_emotions}}}}{{#if {{getvar::NMPEnabled}}}}♢ || [BOUNDARY] AURA OF EMOTIONS × MENTAL STATE ACCESS
Aura manifestations are physical world evidence. They do not expose the complete private state that caused them.

SOURCE OF THE CUE
Use already established current emotion/state and the Aura world rule. Mental Projection owns applicable private state rather than Aura independently inventing another emotional reading.{{#if {{getvar::NMPg_affect}}}} MP Affect/Emotion records may support the broad manifested cue, but never derive an aura by mechanically translating a score, copying an exact intensity, or exposing the tracker. Conflicting simultaneous emotions can yield mixed, ambiguous, unstable, or selectively dominant manifestations when the fiction supports it.{{/if}}

WHAT AN OBSERVER GETS
An observer receives only what their position, senses, attention, training and the actual manifestation make available: broad emotional color, suppression strain, or a concrete physical phenomenon such as heat, mist, light, scent, static, dimming, or pressure. Distance, obstruction, distraction, sensory limits and established suppression skill still matter. Out of range means no observation.

Seeing an aura does not grant its target, cause, memory, motive, exact intensity, private wording, future choice, diagnosis, tracker values, or narrator knowledge. Interpretation remains character-owned and fallible. A trained reader may make a finer supported inference, never omniscience. Feed the visible cue into Knowledge Map / Information Asymmetry as observed evidence when those systems are active; keep interpretation separate from observation.

SUPPRESSION
Aura suppression is the world mechanic's trained act. Mental Projection's expressive inhibition, self-control, fear of disclosure, or desire for privacy may motivate an attempt, but no MP number automatically grants successful suppression. Use established skill, effort, conditions and the world rule. If suppression works imperfectly, observers perceive only the actual residual cue or strain; they do not learn what was hidden merely because suppression occurred.

STATE UPDATE
The aura is an outward consequence of current state, not a second cause that re-applies the same emotion to its owner. Reactions by other people can become genuinely new events and then update their own state normally. Do not feed an aura back into the emitting character as a duplicate causal charge merely because it was displayed.
{{#if {{.NPCInteriorityMode == Hidden}}}}
PRESENTATION
Hidden Interiority changes what private prose the reader sees; it does not erase a physically manifested aura from the fiction. Render the world-visible phenomenon outside <nemo-interiority> blocks while retaining its private cause in the normal hidden/private state channel. Never expose the hidden prose or full MP snapshot through the aura.
{{/if}}
AUTHORSHIP
The active User Role Contract still controls whose private state Nemo may author. For a protected human-controlled player, do not invent an unprovided emotion, motive, thought or interpretation merely to make Aura fire. Use an aura for that character only when its emotional basis or resulting manifestation is established by supplied canon/current input or otherwise permitted world-resolved state. Fully authored in-world characters resolve normally before deriving the outward cue.

Deception/tells remain subordinate to stronger world rules. If another active premise removes deliberate deception, do not invent a deceptive act merely so Aura can reveal it. Privacy, refusal, sincere error and ordinary uncertainty remain possible.
{{else}}{{#if {{.NPCInteriorityMode == Hidden}}}}♢ || [BOUNDARY] AURA OF EMOTIONS × HIDDEN INTERIORITY
Aura manifestations are physical world evidence, not reader access to a complete private mind. Observers receive only the manifested cue available to their position, senses, attention and training. Seeing broad emotional color never grants motive, memory, target, exact intensity, private thought or narrator-only knowledge. {{#if {{getvar::NemoInterpreterEnabled}}}}Interpretation stays grounded in the visible cue and leaves inaccessible details unknown.{{else}}Interpretation remains fallible.{{/if}}

Hidden Interiority changes what private prose the reader sees; it does not erase a physically manifested aura from the fiction. Render the world-visible phenomenon outside <nemo-interiority> blocks. Never copy hidden prose into visible aura description as an explanation.

The active User Role Contract controls whose private emotion may be authored. For a protected human-controlled player, do not invent an unprovided emotion merely to make Aura fire; require supplied/established emotional basis or an otherwise permitted manifestation. Fully authored in-world characters may be resolved normally. Suppression follows established skill and conditions; seeing strain does not reveal what was hidden.

Any observer's interpretation is an inference from the cue, not fact. Deception/tells remain subordinate to stronger world premises; privacy, refusal, sincere error and uncertainty remain possible.
{{/if}}{{/if}}{{/if}}
{{trim}}

prompts.name: 🧩 Dreamscape · MP Clock Ownership
prompts.content:
{{// @category Mental-Projection }}{{// @tooltip Automatic Dreamscape clock ownership for Mental Projection. Stores a compatibility directive only when Dreamscape and MP coexist. }}{{// @icon 🌫️ }}{{// @badge AUTO }}{{// @hidden }}
{{setvar::NDTActive::0}}{{setvar::NDTMPDirective::}}{{#if {{getvar::NemoWorldMod_v11_155_world_augments_dreamscape_reality}}}}{{setvar::NDTActive::1}}{{/if}}
{{#if {{getvar::NDTActive}}}}{{#if {{getvar::NMPEnabled}}}}{{#setvar::NDTMPDirective}}
DREAMSCAPE TIME OWNERSHIP
Dreamscape may make experienced duration diverge from the shared material clock. Distinguish them only when the fiction actually establishes a divergence; otherwise use one ordinary elapsed interval and do not manufacture dilation.

- WORLD ELAPSED: diegetic material time shared with bodies, outside locations and ordinary simultaneous threads. Passive physiology, wound healing, hunger/thirst, drug metabolism, sleep debt, equipment processes and other material-time effects use this clock unless established dream physics explicitly transfer or replace them.
- EXPERIENCED DURATION: the subjective sequence lived inside the relevant dream layer. Thoughts, appraisals, memories, fear, desire, decisions and other genuinely experienced events may change Mental Projection because those events occurred to that mind, even when little world time passed. Do not multiply passive body/chemistry decay or recovery merely because the dream felt long.

A dream event is one cause, not one cause per apparent hour. Apply actual experienced events through their normal MP definitions and causal scopes. Long subjective duration alone does not manufacture repeated stress, relationship gains, skill practice, nutrition, wound healing or hormone changes. Repetition requires repeated experienced events; passive change requires the clock owned by that field.

MEMORY AND SEQUENCE
A memory formed in a long subjective sequence may contain that internal order and felt duration while still being recent on the world clock. Keep sequence/experienced-age separate from objective timestamp or outside elapsed time. Do not falsify world chronology to make the memory feel old, and do not erase the experienced sequence because only a breath passed outside.

WAKING / CROSS-LAYER EFFECTS
Dreamscape already permits fear, injury, desire, revelations or bargains to leave marks after waking when the setting supports that. Carry across only the consequences established by the active world rules and actual event. Do not automatically export dream-body fatigue, resources, healing, damage or elapsed hours into the waking body. Conversely, a supported persistent psychological or supernatural consequence remains real even if the outside interval was brief.

When continuity needs the distinction, keep a concise clock relation in the existing story_context/continuity note rather than creating a second state engine or new numeric meter. State which layer/clock owns an effect only when ambiguity matters. Narrative Stage held-turn counts remain accepted-reply bookkeeping and are never converted into dream years or world elapsed time.
{{/setvar}}{{/if}}{{/if}}{{trim}}

Use any supported {{getvar::NARName}} classification only as sourced characterization. MP's active definitions own current conditions, numeric scales, evidence, updates and accepted endpoint. Use the selected engine's embedded taxonomy and supported classifications. Insufficient character evidence for one axis leaves that axis uncertain, not the entire classification or MP state empty.
